errors.evidence: The chart displays 18 categories on the horizontal axis, not 15.
The chart does not have a visible y-axis with tick marks or labeled intervals. Stating that the interval is a fixed 5% is a hallucination.
The actual range for the category '处所' (place) is 17.3% to 19.5%. The description states an incorrect lower bound of 17.1%.

errors.text_span: 其余类别的百分比均低于8%
errors.evidence: The lowest value for the '方向' category is 8.7%, not below 8%. While the statement may be intended to refer to categories after '方向', it is poorly phrased and technically incorrect as '方向' is part of the 'other' categories after the top three.
The category '角色' (role) does not exist in the chart.
The category '形象距离' does not exist in the chart. The chart has '显式距离' (explicit distance) and '隐式距离' (implicit distance).
The category '服式距离' does not exist in the chart. This is likely a misreading or hallucination based on '隐式距离' (implicit distance).
No bars in the chart have a value of exactly 0%. The lowest values shown are 0.1% or 0.2%. Claiming any value is 'equal to 0%' is factually incorrect.
